questions.question: What happened in chapter 26?
options: A great battle against the Midianites
A second census of the new generation
A famine that struck the wilderness camp
A festival of thanksgiving to the LORD
questions.answer: A second census of the new generation

questions.question: Why was the new census taken?
options: To keep a record for the coming war
To number the priests for the temple
To divide the land among the tribes
To set the amount of the temple tax
questions.answer: To divide the land among the tribes

questions.question: Almost none counted in the first census were still alive, just as God had said.
This census counted the new _____ that had grown up in the wilderness.
The land was to be divided as an inheritance according to the _____ of names.
